datasets.purpose: IPC Classification spatial data in different IPC scenarios collected by FEWS NET enumerators on a regular schedule (typically monthly).

lineage.description: FEWS NET enumerators conducted regular (typically monthly) field surveys across El Salvador to classify food insecurity conditions using the IPC framework. Geographic data were compiled into spatial datasets (GeoJSON/KML) with IPC phase classifications, scenarios, and temporal metadata for 2021 near-term projections.
